name: channel-green
description: Channel Green - a cozy open-source pixel-art social world by ZeroTheory.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n realtime,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @channel-green/realtime" "npm run dev -w @channel-green/web"
scripts.build: npm run content:build && npm run build -w @channel-green/realtime && npm run build -w @channel-green/web
